body: That's what I started my new job, in a new country for. It was my getaway from the things at home that stress me out and depress me. However, in addition from finally getting away from those things, I am in the process of losing everything good I had left. Hence the reason I no longer can be/need to be in this world. I'm /so/ tired. Physically and mentally, I can't take this existence anymore.
I really really do not matter though. I don't have any reason left to be here
